correctness.rationale: For strictly positive alternating transverse orbits, exact semicircular solutions of the two half-plane linear centers give a physical 2π return P=f², with f(u)=φ(−u). Every degree-n polynomial has deg(P^k−id)=n^{2k}, yielding an absolute real-root bound. The explicit Chebyshev f(u)=1/2+(1+δ)(−1)^{n+1}T_n(2u−1)/2, δ>0, has exactly n separated strict inverse branches from [0,1] into compact interior subintervals. Every branch word w of length m has an interior fixed point by endpoint IVT; distinct cylinder intervals and degree n^m enforce exactly n^m distinct simple real roots of f^m−id, all iterates positive. Applying m=2k gives n^{2k} return points; Möbius inversion gives primitive cycles and zeta 1/(1−n²z); simplicity of all 2k and 4k iterates excludes both ±1 return multipliers. Strict critical/end margins persist under coefficient perturbations and provide one open family simultaneously for all periods. Independent exact Sturm/root counting: (n,m)=(2,4) 16 roots, (3,2) 9, (4,2) 16, finite corroboration only.
